lines.beaver_en: Dr. Kim, do you still do research late at night?
lines.learner: 네, 경영학 석사 때부터 습관이 됐어요.
lines.en: Yes, it became a habit during my business master's.
lines.roman: Ne, gyeongyeonghak seoksa ttaebuteo seupgwani dwaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: You originally studied business? I didn't know.
lines.learner: 네, 그런데 지금은 인문학을 연구하고 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, but now I'm researching the humanities.
lines.roman: Ne, geureonde jigeumeun inmunhageul yeonguhago isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 인문학은 자리가 적잖아요. 걱정 안 되세요?
lines.beaver_en: There are few jobs in the humanities. Aren't you worried?
lines.beaver_roman: Inmunhageun jariga jeokjanayo. Geokjeong an doeseyo?
lines.en: Of course I am. But I couldn't give it up.

lines.beaver_en: Academic competition is fierce too. Why do you keep going?
lines.en: To put it in a word, I want to understand people.

lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me a bit more?
lines.learner: 숫자만으로는 사람 마음을 다 알 수 없었어요.
lines.en: Numbers alone couldn't show me people's hearts.
lines.roman: Sutjamaneuroneun saram maeumeul da al su eopseosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그래서 학문을 바꾸신 거군요. 쉽지 않았겠어요.
lines.beaver_en: So that's why you switched fields. It must have been hard.
lines.beaver_roman: Geuraeseo hangmuneul bakkusin geogunyo. Swipji anatgesseoyo.
lines.learner: 네, 처음엔 학식이 부족해서 많이 힘들었어요.
lines.en: Yes, at first I lacked learning, so it was tough.
lines.roman: Ne, cheoeumen haksigi bujokaeseo mani himdeureosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: These days everyone praises your skills.
lines.en: Not at all, I still have a long way to go.

lines.learner: 학술 모임을 만들어서 같이 공부하고 싶어요.
lines.en: I want to start an academic group and study together.
lines.roman: Haksul moimeul mandeureoseo gachi gongbuhago sipeoyo.

lines.beaver: 좋네요. 경영학과 인문학을 같이 하는 모임이요?
lines.beaver_en: Nice. A group for both business and the humanities?
lines.beaver_roman: Jonneyo. Gyeongyeonghakgwa inmunhageul gachi haneun moimiyo?
lines.learner: 네, 두 학문이 서로 밑거름이 될 수 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, the two fields can be a foundation for each other.
lines.roman: Ne, du hangmuni seoro mitgeoreumi doel su isseoyo.

lines.learner: 고마워요. 그럼 다음 주에 같이 이야기해요.
lines.en: Thanks. Let's talk about it next week, then.
lines.roman: Gomawoyo. Geureom daeum jue gachi iyagihaeyo.
